case_number: 2024 INSC 967; CRIMINAL APPEAL NOS. OF 2024 (Arising out of Special Leave Petition (Criminal) Nos.9138-9139 of 2017)
summary: Sanction under s.197 CrPC mandatory for prosecution of public servants; demolition during official duty; good faith defense under relevant Act; trial court summoning based on prima facie evidence; High Court erred in not quashing proceedings lacking sanction; private complaint under s.200 CrPC; no criminal intent shown in discharge of official functions; legal immunity for bona fide acts.
legal_provisions_cited: The Punjab Scheduled Roads and Controlled Areas Restriction of Unregulated Development Act, 1963 s.20, s.21
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; criminal proceedings quashed for absence of mandatory sanction under s.197 CrPC; High Court order set aside.
